title: Upon Hearing of a Calamity or Death
arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتۡهُم مُّصِيبَةٞ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّآ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
translation: Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return
transliteration: Allatheena itha asabathum museebatun qaloo inna lillahi wainna ilayhi rajiAAoona

title: After Reciting Istirja (Following the Verse Above)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
translation: Aey Allah! Mujhe meri museebat mein ajr (sawab) de aur mujhe iske badle behtar ata farma.
transliteration: Allahumma-jurni fi museebati wakhluf li khayran minha

title: For the Deceased (Salat al-Janazah)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا
translation: Aey Allah! Hamare zinda aur hamare murda ko, hamare hazir aur hamare ghaib ko, hamare chhote aur hamare bade ko, hamare mard aur hamari aurat ko bakhsh de.
transliteration: Allahumma-ghfir li hayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina, wa sagheerina wa kabeerina, wa dhakarina wa unthana

title: Consoling the Bereaved
arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
translation: Jo Allah ne liya wo usi ka tha, aur jo usne diya wo bhi usi ka tha, aur har cheez ka uske paas ek muqarrar waqt hai. Pas sabr karo aur sawab ki neeyat rakho.
transliteration: Inna lillahi ma akhadh, wa lahu ma a'ta, wa kullu shay'in 'indahu bi-ajalin musamma, faltasbir wal-tahtasib
note: The Prophet ﷺ sent this message to his own daughter when her son was dying.

title: Visiting a Grave
arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
translation: Salamati ho tum par, aey qabron walon, momino aur musalmano! Aur be-shak hum bhi, Allah chahe to, tumse aa milne wale hain. Main Allah se hamare aur tumhare liye aafiyat maangta hoon.
transliteration: Assalamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'minina wal-muslimin, wa inna in sha'a Allahu bikum lahiqun, as'alullaha lana wa lakumul-'afiyah
